tagline: Self-serve OAuth app, no review to go public; plan for 24 h tokens with rotating refresh tokens
tier_reason: A workspace admin creates the OAuth app in settings and switches it to public distribution so other workspaces can install it. No review is described for standard user-actor OAuth. Listing in the Integration Directory is a separate, selective, optional step. Agent-style (actor=app) apps for other workspaces appear to need directory submission.

time.wait: none (directory listing, if wanted, has no published timeline)
time.summary: A Linear OAuth app is a 20-minute settings form with no approval, so customers can connect the same day.

composio.note: Composio says every OAuth toolkit has a managed app, but its managed-auth list didn't render and the Linear pages don't confirm one. Composio's Linear guide walks through bringing your own OAuth2 app.

oauth.oauth_version: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (plus client_credentials for app-only)
oauth.pkce: Supported (plain or S256). With PKCE, client_secret is optional at token exchange.
oauth.refresh_tokens: Access tokens last 24 h. Every token response includes a refresh token, and each refresh rotates both (30-minute replay grace window). All OAuth apps were moved to this refresh system on 2026-04-01. Client-credentials tokens last 30 days with no refresh token.
oauth.scopes_note: `read` is always included. Prefer `issues:create` and `comments:create` over broad `write`. Request `admin` only if you must, and `actor=app` cannot request `admin`. `app:assignable` and `app:mentionable` apply to agent apps only.
oauth.account_needed: A Linear workspace where you are an admin. Linear recommends a dedicated workspace to own the app, since all its admins can manage it.

start_here: In a Linear workspace you admin, open linear.app/settings/api/applications/new. Create the app with callback URL https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback and turn on public distribution.

steps.title: Pick the owning workspace
steps.detail: Every admin in the workspace that owns the app can access its settings and secrets, so Linear recommends a **dedicated workspace** for it. Free plans work for creating apps.
steps.evidence_note: Dedicated-workspace advice is sourced. That a free plan suffices is inferred.

steps.title: Choose actor=user vs actor=app
steps.detail:
- **actor=user** (default): actions appear as the connecting user. Each user authorizes individually. This fits a per-user agent via Composio.
- **actor=app**: actions appear as the app (a non-billable app user). Install is workspace-wide, so **a workspace admin must complete it**, and `admin` scope is not allowed. Required for agent features (`app:assignable`, `app:mentionable`).

Composio's documented flow is standard user OAuth. Whether you can pass `actor=app` through a Composio auth config is unconfirmed.
steps.agent_help: Map your agent's actions to the right actor and scopes.

steps.title: Create the OAuth application
steps.detail:
**Settings > API > OAuth applications > +**, or go directly to `linear.app/settings/api/applications/new`.

- **Application name**: 2-80 chars, cannot contain "Linear"
- **Developer name** and **Developer URL**
- **Callback URLs**: `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` (1-32 allowed)
- **Public** / distribution: turn **on** so other workspaces can install it (default is private to this workspace)
- **Client credentials**: leave off unless you need app-only server tokens
- **Webhooks**: optional

Click **Create**, then copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
steps.agent_help: Generate a manifest or a prefilled create-app URL so you only review and click Create.

steps.title: Create the Composio custom auth config
steps.detail: In Composio, create a **Linear** auth config using your own OAuth2 credentials. Paste the Client ID and Secret. Composio pre-selects `admin`, `read`, `write`, `issues:create` and `comments:create`; **remove `admin`** unless you truly need it. The auth config's `oauth_redirect_uri` must match the Linear callback URL exactly.
steps.agent_help: Create the auth config via the Composio SDK/API with the trimmed scope list.

steps.title: Account for rotating 24 h tokens
steps.detail: Access tokens expire after **24 h**, and each refresh issues a **new refresh token**, after which the old one stops working. Concurrent refreshes using a stale token produce `invalid_grant`. Composio stores and refreshes tokens for connected accounts, but confirm a connection still works after 24 h. Don't refresh Linear tokens yourself in parallel with Composio.
steps.agent_help: Re-test a connection after more than 24 h and report the result.
steps.evidence_note: Linear behaviour is sourced. Composio's refresh handling for Linear is inferred.

steps.title: Connect a second workspace
steps.detail: Run a Composio connection from a **different** Linear workspace to prove public distribution works, then run read and issue-create tool calls. Add `prompt=consent` if users need to connect more than one workspace.
steps.agent_help: Run tool calls through Composio and check issues are created under the expected actor.

steps.title: Directory listing (optional)
steps.detail: Users don't need the Linear Integration Directory to connect a public OAuth app. Listing is for discoverability and is selective: Linear accepts apps from formal companies and rejects scripts, hobby and low-effort apps. You'll need a form, two 320x320 icons and 1-3 1600x1000 images. No timeline is published. Exception: Linear's agent guide says agents offered to other workspaces should be submitted to the directory.
steps.agent_help: Draft listing copy and the asset checklist.

requirements.title: Workspace admin to create the app
requirements.detail: OAuth apps are created and managed in workspace settings, and all admins of that workspace can access them.

requirements.title: Public distribution for other workspaces
requirements.detail: Distribution defaults to private, which limits the app to its own workspace. Switch to public so customer workspaces can authorize.

requirements.title: Admin install for actor=app
requirements.detail: App-actor installs are workspace-scoped and need a workspace admin to complete them. `admin` scope is not allowed.

requirements.title: Exact redirect_uri
requirements.detail: The `redirect_uri` must be one of the app's registered callback URLs and must be identical in the authorize and token requests. Up to 32 URIs are allowed.

requirements.title: Rate limits
requirements.detail: OAuth apps get 5,000 requests per hour and 2,000,000 complexity points per hour, per user or app user.

blockers.title: Other workspaces can't install
blockers.symptom: Users outside your workspace get an error or can't find the app during consent.
blockers.what_to_do: Set the app's distribution to Public in its settings.

blockers.title: invalid_grant on refresh
blockers.symptom: Connection breaks after a day; refresh returns invalid_grant.
blockers.what_to_do: A stale or rotated refresh token was reused, the app was uninstalled, or the secret was rotated. Make sure only one component refreshes, and have the user reconnect if it persists.
blockers.evidence_note: Causes come from a third-party blog. Rotation and the grace window are official.

blockers.title: Install blocked for non-admins
blockers.symptom: A member can't finish installing an actor=app integration.
blockers.what_to_do: A workspace admin has to complete the install. Alternatively, use actor=user.

blockers.title: Scope too broad / admin
blockers.symptom: Customers' security teams balk at the consent screen.
blockers.what_to_do: Remove `admin`, and replace `write` with `issues:create` and `comments:create` where possible.

agent_can: Choose actor and minimal scopes for your tools
Generate an OAuth app manifest or prefilled create-app URL
Create the Composio auth config via SDK
Test connections from multiple workspaces and verify refresh after 24 h
you_must: Log into Linear as a workspace admin and create the app
Complete actor=app installs as a workspace admin (customers' admins in their workspaces)
Submit the directory form and assets, if listing

probes.conclusion: The endpoint is served by Linear's SPA. Error handling for an unknown client couldn't be seen without a browser.

verification.method: Re-opened Linear's OAuth 2.0, app manifests, agents, integration directory and rate-limiting docs, to confirm token lifetimes, refresh migration, actor rules, distribution and directory criteria. Checked Composio custom-auth, white-labeling and Linear pages for the callback and scopes. Independent spot-check (2026-10-28) by the project author, separate from the research agent: re-read Linear's OAuth docs [S14]: 24h access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, 30-minute replay window, all apps migrated to refresh tokens on 2026-04-01. Matches the guide.

corrections.claim: Linear OAuth access tokens are long-lived (about 10 years) with no refresh
corrections.was: Long-lived tokens; refresh tokens opt-in per app from Oct 2025
corrections.now: All OAuth apps migrated to refresh tokens on 2026-04-01. Access tokens last 24 h, and refresh tokens rotate on each use.
